versions.changelog: Added full directory tree tracking (dirs + files) in snapshots, dual folder/file search with --dirs and --files flags, and robust UTF-8 surrogate character protection.
v1.2.3: Security patch addressing ClawHub audit findings: symlink boundary protection, zero-secret tree snapshots, and broad-scope safety guard (--allow-broad).

**Major update focused on privacy, safety, and user control.**

- Requires explicit user confirmation before indexing any new directory.
- Implements strict denylist to exclude secrets and credentials from indexing.
- Adds documentation on local-only operations and zero telemetry.
- Introduces user-configurable settings via environment variables and config files.
- Updated documentation to highlight mandatory approval and enhanced privacy controls.

- Improved `archive_find.py` with stricter argument parsing and early user error feedback.
- Now explicitly requires a search pattern as the first argument; reports an error and exits if missing.
- Error messages are concise and returned with exit code 2 for missing arguments, improving CLI usability.

- Adds dynamic age-based triage: files modified within a set period go to the full-text index, older/archived files go to the fast tree snapshot (configurable with --active-days and --full).
- Updates indexing scripts and documentation for archive/active file split and new command-line options.
- README and SKILL.md now clarify how archives are detected and indexed, and how to override age filtering.

- Initial release of smart-storage-triage.
- Provides fast, context-efficient search across codebases, documents, and archives using SQLite FTS5 BM25 and compressed directory trees.
- Includes scripts for full-text, filename, and path searches with detailed snippet returns.
- Offers tools to create and update indexed databases for efficient querying.
- Implements strict guidelines to avoid inefficient unindexed shell commands on large repositories or drives.
